user.title: Share your solar production with Kilowattlas
user.description:
Kilowattlas builds a public, live map of solar production from readings shared by homes like yours. The service is free for you.

Before you continue, this is what happens:

- Your Home Assistant home position is sent to Kilowattlas as a suggestion for where your installation is. You can adjust it on the website before approving.
- Your installation's position, capacity and live production are shown publicly on kilowattlas.com. No name, account or e-mail is shown.
- Every reading from the power sensor you choose is sent as soon as your sensor reports it.
- **Your data is sold on.** Kilowattlas sells the shared production data to third parties: electricity market participants use it to make forecasts and steer other production so the power system runs more efficiently, and service partners use it to see when an installation is not performing as it should, so they can contact you about a fault.
- Your data is also used to give you benchmarks of how your installation performs compared with similar ones.
- You can stop at any time: remove this integration, then delete the installation on kilowattlas.com to erase its history.
